fixed.summary: A fill of a status or rarity colour carries its own ink (`bg-success text-success-fg`, and the same for danger, warn, info, epic, legendary and critical) in 27 components, where the ink was the page's ground or another colour's: Claimed, Missed, Cleared, Next and the player's row read in the light scheme.
The level-up's disc is the theme's glass, not the gold ink used as a fill (a solid black or white disc).

The milestone ribbon is `bg-epic text-epic-fg`; Round won is `text-gold`, which reads on the panel in light; a chosen tool is the `hud-accent` fill with its ink in every pack, where a pack's button art covered the fill.
Their words sit on a HUD plate (`Plate.frame`) instead of straight over the scene with a text shadow, so they read over any scene and a pack dresses them.
A disabled button has a ground: the `fill` wash over `surface`, where it was the wash alone and its label could not be read over a scene.
